# Scriptum AI

> Scriptum AI (tryscriptum.ai) is a legal AI platform for transactional lawyers, built in Northern Ireland,: "the operating system for transactional legal teams". Lawyers draft inside Microsoft Word from their firm's own precedents and house style, agree terms with the client and the other side in one secure matter workspace, and negotiate with the firm's own playbook. Every approved change builds a clause library and negotiation record that the firm owns. It is built for transactional work at mid-sized firms with between 5 and 500 fee earners in the UK, Ireland, the USA and Canada, and for in-house legal teams, as a transactional-only, published-price alternative to broad legal AI platforms such as Harvey, Legora and Microsoft Copilot for Legal.

Scriptum AI is based in Northern Ireland and backed by TechStart and Invest NI. (Not to be confused with other, unrelated products or companies that also use the name "Scriptum".) Scriptum AI (tryscriptum.ai) is not connected with Scriptum AI of Madrid (scriptum-ai.com) or with the Scriptum markdown and writing apps.

## Key facts

- What it is: AI-assisted drafting, review, negotiation and knowledge capture for transactional legal work, delivered as a Microsoft Word add-in plus a shared matter workspace.
- Who it is for: transactional lawyers (M&A, private equity and venture capital, commercial contracts, commercial property, employment) in mid-sized law firms with between 5 and 500 fee earners in the UK, Ireland, the USA and Canada, and in-house legal teams.
- What it is not: it does not do litigation support, large-scale document review, multi-jurisdiction legal research or regulatory monitoring.
- Agents: drafting agent and review agent (Starter); negotiation agent working inside limits a partner sets, and a collaboration agent for client and partner questions (Pro). A named lawyer approves before anything reaches the document.
- Knowledge: clause choices, negotiation positions and deal outcomes are captured as lawyers work, into a clause library and playbook that belong to the firm contractually and stay when people leave.
- Pricing (published, per user per month, excluding VAT/taxes, billed monthly): Starter £79 / €95 / $105 / C$149; Pro £119 / €139 / $159 / C$225; Firm custom. See https://tryscriptum.ai/pricing.
- Contact: info@scriptumai.co
- Security: customer documents are never used to train models; each firm's data is isolated at the database; data is hosted in the EU. ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certification are pending.
